meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审一遍已完成的改动，在交付前盯住目标、约束、代码质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成一批改动，准备交付却想先确认没有遗漏问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished changes and want a final check before handing off the PR

howto.what: Claude 会先在真实界面上亲自做手动 QA,再启动唯一一个 gate reviewer 子代理,对照目标、约束、安全等项与 QA 证据审计整个改动,最后给出 APPROVE 或 REVIEW FAILED。
howto.when: 在 PR 交付前,或用户明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。只要 QA 矩阵出现失败行,审查即在此结束并报 REVIEW FAILED,不再派 gate reviewer。

say.text: 帮我 review 一下这次改动,做门禁审查
say.note: 先做手动 QA,再派一个 gate reviewer

say.text: 用 review-work 审查这个分支,准备交付 PR
对这份 diff 做 gate review,只用一个 reviewer

howto.what_en: Claude first runs hands-on manual QA on the real surface itself, then launches one gate reviewer sub-agent to audit the change against goal, constraints, code, security, and QA evidence. Output: a QA matrix and APPROVE or REVIEW FAILED.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Any failing QA row ends the review as REVIEW FAILED, with no gate reviewer spawned.

say_en.text: Review this change as a gate review
say_en.note: Runs manual QA, then one gate reviewer
